assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production website illustration for an existing literary curiosity-cabinet tool launcher. Create a single compact vintage desktop screen-recording instrument representing the Cap app: a handsome small walnut-cased monitor with a softly rounded rectangular ivory glass screen, restrained brass frame and base, black side panel, one small dark red circular recording indicator and a tiny square stop symbol on the screen. Three-quarter front view, screen face clearly visible. No camera lens and no film reel; the silhouette must read as a computer screen recorder. Style: carefully painted antique scientific-catalog object, realistic tactile walnut, aged brass, black enamel and warm ivory glass, gently worn engraved details, warm neutral lighting, precise crisp silhouette and a tiny soft contact shadow. Match a set of antique fountain-pen drafting papers, a black leather ledger, a vintage broadcast microphone and an old film reel. One isolated object, fully in view, centered, occupying about 78% of a square canvas with at least 10% clear safe margin on every side. Genuine transparent background with alpha, no solid backdrop, no ground plane, no surrounding cabinet or shelf, no labels, no letters or words, no logos, no watermark, no UI card. Restrained warm walnut/ivory/black/brass palette, only a small muted red record dot. Designed to remain recognizable at 66 to 132px display size.
